en.p: There are 1 red card, 1 blue card, 3 yellow cards, and 3 purple cards. In how many ways can all 8 cards be distributed among three students $\mathrm{A}$, $\mathrm{B}$, $\mathrm{C}$ according to the following rules? (Cards of the same color are indistinguishable.) [4 points]

box: (A) Students $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{B}$ each receive at least 1 card; student $\mathrm{C}$ may receive no cards.
(B) The number of different colors among the cards student $\mathrm{A}$ receives is at most 3.
